declarations.message:
function message(error, c) {
  return error?.code === 'REVISION_CONFLICT' || error?.code === 'CONFLICT'
    ? c.conflict
    : error?.code === 'RECENT_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED'
      ? c.reauth
      : error?.code === 'NOT_FOUND'
        ? c.notFound
        : c.error
}
